subject: SOC2 Evidence Runbook & Roles — Initial MAP and Timeline
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@helixa.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@helixa.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 evidence runbook & MAP for Helixa POC

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to move towards an eval. As part of our procurement & security review we need a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out: roles, milestones, and what SOC 2 evidence we can expect to collect during the POC.

Can you please loop in your GRC point of contact and share a short evidence runbook (what evidence we can expect and who will provide it)? Our target is to complete security review and procurement sign-off within three weeks so we can start the POC in early December.

Ive attached our standard security questionnaire to kick things off. Also, who should I expect to see on evidence requests (names/emails) so we can route internal reviewers?

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of IT Security | Helixa
elena.park@helixa.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: Helixa-Security-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@helixa.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence runbook & MAP for Helixa POC

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the questionnaire. Looping in Markus (Head of GRC) and Hannah (Customer Success lead) who will be our points for evidence & timeline.

Quick proposed approach:
- We’ll draft a short evidence runbook (1–2 pages) that maps your questionnaire items to artifacts we can provide (logs, architecture diagrams, data flow statements, SOC 2 report references).
- Proposed MAP milestones: kickoff + scoping (this week), evidence collection (days 3–10), remediation/clarifications (days 11–14), procurement acceptance (by day 21).
- Owner assignments: Markus will own evidence requests; Hannah will manage scheduling and internal acceptance criteria with your ops team.

I attached our MAP template and a first-pass runbook (v0.1) for your review. Markus — can you confirm availability to start evidence collection this afternoon?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-map-template.xlsx; redwood-soc2-evidence-runbook-v0.1.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@helixa.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence runbook & MAP for Helixa POC

Hi Elena,

Thanks Priya — Ill take point on evidence. Quick introductions: Im Markus Klein (Head, GRC) and Ill be your primary reviewer for SOC 2 scope and evidence requests. Hannah will coordinate calendar availability / artifact handoffs.

Summary of what Im proposing (short & actionable):
1) Evidence runbook (attached v0.1) — each row lists the questionnaire item, recommended artifact, likely owner, and an estimated turnaround.
2) Immediate asks from Helixa: confirm POC data handling model (PII/no-PII, retention window) and any required attestations for log access.
3) Milestones (concrete dates):
   - Tues 11/24: Confirm scope and Helixa POC data handling (you)
   - Thu 11/26: Redwood shares remaining artifacts + access instructions (us)
   - Fri 12/04: Evidence requested and uploaded to shared Drive
   - Mon 12/07: Helixa security team completes review and provides any follow-up asks

Please see the attached runbook and a link to a shared Drive folder where well deposit files:
https://drive.google.com/redwood/Helixa-MAP

Attachments: redwood-soc2-evidence-runbook-v0.1.pdf; helixa-scoping-notes.docx

A few clarifying questions:
- Will Helixa require our full SOC 2 Type II report or only scoped artifacts?
- Do you have a designated technical contact who can pull logs if we request them?

If the timeline above looks ok, Ill open the Drive folder and create individual evidence requests in the shared tracker.

—Markus
Markus Klein | Head of GRC, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: Tom Rhodes <tom.rhodes@helixa.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@helixa.com>
Cc: security@helixa.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence runbook & MAP for Helixa POC

Thanks — that all looks good. Quick answers:
- Helixa prefers scoped artifacts initially (logs + config screenshots + architecture diagram). We may request the full SOC 2 report later, but for procurement sign-off scoped artifacts should be fine.
- Our designated technical contact for the POC is Mike Salazar (mike.salazar@helixa.com) — he can pull logs and coordinate uploads.

Well confirm scope by Tuesday 11/24 as proposed. In the meantime, please send any access instructions (SFTP/Drive permissions) and well make sure Mike is looped into the Drive folder.

Tom Rhodes
Director, Procurement | Helixa
tom.rhodes@helixa.com
